this_court: The Fifth Circuit holds that the Board's cancellation-of-removal hardship determination is a reviewable mixed question of law under 8 U.S.C. § 1252(a)(2)(D).
quote: When faced with the same question, two of our other sister circuits have disagreed that a cancellation-of-removal hardship determination is a non-discretionary mixed question after Guerrero-Lasprilla,
cite: Guerrero Trejo v. Garland, 3 F.4th 760 (5th Cir. 2021)
